notes.title: Update 09/26/2019
notes.notes:
Minor fixes.

 Fixed an issue where clicking too fast on "Continue Story" would cause the music to stop upon loading.
 Fixed an issue where clicking too fast on "Continue Story" would cause the screen to stay black.
 Improved how the transitions are handled during the logos at the launch of the game to try to prevent rare cases where the script would get stuck (trying blind here, note that you can disable these logos in the options for a faster launch).
 Improved how the transitions are handled when closing tabs in-game to try to prevent rare cases where the menu at the bottom of the screen would no longer work (trying blind here).
 Added a 1 second delay on the quicksave function as spamming it could lead to unexpected results.
 Fixed an issue where it was not possible to hide the interface with the hotkey H when the message log was open.
 Fixed issues within the save and load functions to ensure they don't throw errors that could cause unexpected results.


The demo version has been updated with these changes too.

If you ever experience an issue with Esper - Make You Live Again, don't hesitate to report it, I'll be glad to help and fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: Release date set on May 31st, 2019
notes.notes: Esper - Make You Live Again will be released on Steam on May 31st, 2019.
